title: Patchpad: SDK tutorial fixes & sample app to-dos
content:
Morning sprint dump (13 Mar 2026) -- lightweight, messy, meant for me and 1-2 others.

Top-of-mind goals:
- unblock JS quickstart (most reported friction: missing init example + CORS note)
- patch sample-newsroom app to include streaming example + error-handling snippet
- triage 3 doc regressions flagged by QA on staging site

Notes / observed friction (from support threads + slack):
1) Quickstart (hosted API)
   - Current quickstart shows the fetch() wrapper but no explicit apiKey example; people copy/paste and get 401s.
   - Add small snippet:
     const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
     // or: const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/generate', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` } })
   - Also call out: CORS preflight on browser usage; recommend server-side token proxy for quick demos.
   - ACTION: add paragraph + two-line example + link to token best-practices doc. (owner: Kai)

2) Streaming examples in sample-newsroom
   - The sample app uses polling; need streaming with incremental UI updates (swr patch).
   - Live snippet candidate (pseudo):
     const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', messages });
     for await (const chunk of stream) { appendToUI(chunk.text) }
   - Also catch network disconnect and fallback to regenerate request.
   - ACTION: implement streaming wrapper and small server-proxy example. (owner: me)

3) Embeddings tutorial mismatch
   - Docs show embeddings_endpoint v1/embeddings but SDK method is client.embeddings.create() in the current release. We need a reconciled example.
   - ACTION: update docs and add migration note for older SDKs. (owner: Marta)

4) Type hints & TS examples
   - Problems: examples use any in TypeScript snippets; lint fails for customers using strict tsconfig.
   - Proposed: include typed interfaces for Response, Chunk, StreamIterator. Minimal change to make snippet copy/paste compile.
   - ACTION: create small types file and reference it. (owner: Kai)

5) Error handling and retry guidance
   - Missing explicit guidance for 429 vs 503 handling. Add short table: when to retry, backoff suggestion, example using axios/fetch.
   - ACTION: add to quickstart and streaming docs. (owner: me)

Checklist for sample-newsroom patch (priority):
- [ ] Add streaming client wrapper + server-proxy example (estimate: 4-6h)
- [ ] Add reconnect => fallback regen strategy (1-2h)
- [ ] Update README.md with architecture diagram (a tiny ascii/block diagram is fine) (0.5h)
- [ ] Add unit test for streaming incremental UI (mock stream) (2h)
- [ ] Create GH PR with squash commit + PR template (15m)

Small editorial notes (copyable bits):
- "Use Redwood API keys with care: for browser demos, prefer ephemeral/demo tokens served from a short-lived server endpoint instead of embedding long-lived keys in client code."
- "Streaming is best-effort: provide a clear UX for partial results and an explicit fallback for reconnects or timeouts."

Random scratch TODOs (low priority):
- add short recipe: "embedding similarity search + highlights" for search samples (owner: Marta)
- check sample app's package.json for outdated deps (react 17 -> 18?)
- review localization strings for tutorial UX (eng-translation?)

Bugs/quirks to file as separate tickets (quick notes to create later):
- UI: progress spinner blocks text rendering when streaming (race condition on setState) -> probably stale closure.
- Docs build: markdown code fences with bash triple backticks are being escaped in site generator (investigate).
- CLI: redwood-cli init fails with EEXIST when tmp dir exists on Windows (ask infra).

Meeting points for pairing (this week):
- Wed 11:00am PT "Pair on streaming wrapper" (Kai + Talia)
- Thu 3:00pm PT "Quickstart text edit review" (Marta, Product writer)

Draft PR description (skeleton) for sample-newsroom streaming change:
"Adds streaming chat integration to the sample-newsroom demo. Introduces a minimal server-proxy for token handling, a StreamClient wrapper to normalize chunk iteration, and an incremental UI hook used in the NewsroomArticle component. Includes tests and an update to the README with usage and retry guidance. Closes: #LINEAR-1209"

Short-term plan for today (ordered):
1) Push minimal README tweak for quickstart (5-10m)
2) Start streaming wrapper branch + commit initial interface (1h)
3) Drop a stub PR for syncing embeddings tutorial (comment to ACK) (15m)
4) Triage QA doc regressions (30m)

Notes-to-self: keep the doc tone prescriptive, not prescriptive-legal. Use short code snippets that actually run in Node 18+. When in doubt, prefer: "copy-paste-and-run" over cleverness.

Slack refs / context:
- #devx-help thread: "JS quickstart 401s" (link pinned)
- #support channel: multiple tickets referencing sample-newsroom streaming request timeouts

Quick links to attach to PRs:
- Quickstart page (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVX/Quickstart-Hosted-API
- Streaming design note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Streaming-Design-Notes

End-of-day logging (to fill later)
- time spent: ___
- blockers: ___
- follow-ups: ___

-- T.M.
